title: The AC19 pass-level degrade test is not executable as planned
text: The AC19 pass-level degrade test is not executable as planned: `loadSweepList({ path })` is only a direct loader seam, while production `run-review-pass` calls it with no argument and the current pass dependency surface provides no loader/path injection. Specify an injected loader (or an isolated cwd/filesystem seam) so the orchestration test can actually exercise malformed-list degradation without mutating the committed artifact.
